build_LVISMetric_bbox: build an LVISMetric instance to evaluate bounding box detection metrics on an LVIS dataset with an annotation file
build_LVISMetric_segm_classwise: build an LVISMetric instance to evaluate segmentation metrics classwise with custom IoU thresholds and proposal numbers
test_fast_eval_recall: test the fast_eval_recall method to compute averaged recall results for object proposal evaluation
test_process_data_samples: test the process method to extract predictions and ground truth from a batch of data samples
test_compute_metrics: test the compute_metrics method to calculate AP and AR metrics from processed LVIS detection results
